reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of constrained diffusion leading to a stochastic, single-phase alloy in quinary systems is well-grounded in high-entropy alloy theory, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparison between binary and quinary precursors under the same low-temperature reduction protocol is straightforward to conduct and would give a clear yes/no outcome.
reasons.usefulness: It directly tackles the core challenge of forming homogeneous high-entropy alloy nanoparticles and offers a clear experimental pathway to verify the underlying mechanism.
